paragraphs: The X7 xDrive40i uses BMW's B58 engine — a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-six petrol, paired with a 48V mild-hybrid system. It's the entry-level petrol engine in the X7 range, producing 375hp in the G07 generation. The B58 is a modern, well-regarded engine that replaced the older N55 across BMW's model line-up, and has proven itself a reliable and responsive unit across a wide range of applications, from the 3 Series and 5 Series to the X5 and X7. The X7 was introduced in 2018 and received a facelift in 2022; the xDrive40i has been available from launch and remains the core petrol offering.
about.boldParagraph: The X7 xDrive40i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
